item.title: Inside Joe Manchin's new quest to elect more Independents to Congress
item.description: The former West Virginia senator was a lifelong Democrat before deciding to register as an independent two years ago. He now wants to create similar pathways for other politicians in both parties.

item.title: 3 dead in mass shooting in Seattle. And, U.S. and Iran pause fighting
item.description: A mass shooting at a Seattle festival has left three people dead. And, the U.S. and Iran have been exchanging diplomatic messages after nearly tw weeks of intense fighting.

item.title: France continues to fight devastating wildfires, while progress is made in Spain
item.description: In southern France, a wildfire in the region of Gironde is still active, while two major fires in central Spain are finally coming under control, ahead of the fourth heat wave of the summer.

item.title: In Memphis, an 'anti-crime' task force quietly turned into an ICE crackdown
item.description: The influx of federal agents into the city last fall led to widespread immigration arrests – a majority without criminal convictions. President Trump has said he wants to replicate it elsewhere.

item.title: Baltimore will turn 911 into more than just an emergency number
item.description: Baltimore is rethinking what it means to call 911, and who responds. Callers who don't need police will get help finding social services and healthcare before they actually fall into crisis.

item.title: Can the U.S. and Iran take the off-ramp?
item.description: The U.S. military has paused its airstrikes on Iran after nearly two weeks of intensifying bombing, while diplomatic efforts have pushed forward to try to avert a return to all-out war.

item.title: With just a few primary elections to go, the competitive Senate map keeps shifting
item.description: For Democrats to take control of the U.S. Senate, they have to flip four seats currently held by Republicans. Republicans, meanwhile, are playing defense and pickup opportunities are harder to find.
